strategies.strategyName: Mega Raichu Y + Regieleki Catch Tanks
strategies.text:
Overview

As a flying/dark type yveltal has weaknesses to electric, ice, rock and fairy. By exploiting its weakness to electric using the powerful Mega Raichu Y and rainy weather boost this solo can be overcome fairly comfortably


As Mega Raichu Y is quite fragile and Yveltal has access to the hard hitting hyper beam Regieleki catch tanks are used to extended Mega Raichu’s lifetime and reduce the number of rejoins. This strategy should use anywhere from 3-5 Regielekis

Est Time to Win

285s-295s

Main Strategy

DPS with Mega Raichu Y, when Yveltal throws hyper beam it is recommended to use Regieleki as a Catch Tank to sponge the high damage move and utilize the gained energy to fire back the high power thunder cage. It is also advised to Tick Perfect Cast on Mega Raichu Y and Regieleki to avoid using extra fast moves and thus costing DPS.

This route should be around 3 rejoins with a full Regieleki team. Number of rejoins may vary based on boss aggression and party size. Level 40 Regielekis also work equally as well as Level 50 Regielekis when catch tanking due to the extra energy gained
